title: User-research extract record (frontmatter)
description: ONE SOURCE per file, N FINDING-RECORDS inside it (spec L-2). This type is the outlier among the three: 5b's unit is one convention source and 5c's is one product, but here the queue row and the ticket are one SOURCE while the record is one published FINDING — because how many findings a paper contains is only knowable after the deep read, and finding-level queue rows would force the search child to do the extract's work. L-2a declares this multi-record container as a deviation from the one-contracted-file rule; the path stays one-per-child, so collision safety is unaffected. SHAPE ONLY — whether a claim is faithfully reported is the reviewing twin's judgment.

source_id.description: L-3: `DOI-<doi>`, `ARXIV-<id>` or `WEB-<domain>-<slug>`. The filename is record_filename(source_id), NOT the id — a DOI always contains a slash, which makes this type the most exposed of the three.

cause.description: `source-unreachable` is a retrieval failure, never a finding of absence.

source.description: Present iff outcome is `extracted`. Facts about the SOURCE, shared by every finding in it.

study_date.description: L-6: currency is first-class. A 2009 finding about a UI convention may not hold now, and synthesis cannot weigh recency against an optional field.

study_design.description: One of the four facts the certainty rule branches on (L-4).

sample_size.description: L-7: travels VERBATIM, never recomputed. `null` means the source reports none — which is a fact the certainty rule uses, not a gap.

effect_size.description: A STANDARDIZED effect size as the source states it, verbatim. `null` when none is reported — routine in HCI papers that give means and p-values without one.

access_status.description: L-13. Recording how a source was reached makes the next channel death visible instead of silent.

findings.description: Present iff outcome is `extracted`. One record per published finding; ids are minted HERE, after the read enumerated them.

id.description: `<source-id>#f<N>`. The source id stays extractable as the prefix, so synthesis groups by source for free.

certainty.description: GRADE's four-level VOCABULARY, assigned BY RULE rather than by appraisal (L-4). The validator re-derives it from study_design, sample_size and effect_size and rejects a mismatch — this is arithmetic, not judgment.

transferability.description: L-5: separate from certainty and never folded into it. A methodologically excellent finding from another domain is high-certainty AND low-transferability, and one number hides exactly what the reader needs.

population.description: Who the claim was measured on (L-5/L-6).

platform_context.description: The platform or medium it was measured in — a 2009 desktop result is not a 2026 mobile one.

effect_verbatim.description: The measured effect as the source words it. Never recomputed, never converted.
